snippet.title: [1440p] Wild Assault Early Access Trailer: Embark
snippet.description:
“What gives life meaning?”
“Time is of the essence.”
Follow your instincts. Unleash your raw, feral nature.
Mojave, the Ricky Mountains — wherever our fates cross paths.

Anthro-themed large-scale battleground PvP hero shooter, Wild Assault, launches on April 11, 2025, and will be available on Steam & Epic Games Store, with the Standard Edition priced at $15!
Step into the hunt with the valiants!
————————————————————————————————————————
😼 Wild Assault is an Anthro Tactical Shooter developed with Unreal Engine 5! 
Check it out on Steam:
